task_text: I woke up late and have to leave for work in 10 minutes. I need something quick to eat, and the living room should be tidy so I can grab my things and go.

central_instructions.R1: Prepare a quick meal by slicing and pouring ingredients, then pass the meal to R2.
central_instructions.R2: Receive the meal from R1 and bring it to the living room for you to eat.
central_instructions.R3: Ensure the living room is tidy by organizing light objects and preparing any additional items you need to grab.
central_instructions.R4: Tidy the living room by moving heavy objects and ensuring the space is clear for you to quickly grab your things and go.

agent_plans.R1:
[0-5 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Pick up the knife from the sink basin. (r1_s1)
- R1 [LOCAL] Slice the bread on the counter. (r1_s2)
- R1 [LOCAL] Slice the tomato on the counter. (r1_s3)
- R1 [LOCAL] Place the sliced bread and tomato on a plate from the cabinet. (r1_s4)

[5-10 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Pour some salt from the shaker onto the sliced tomato. (r1_s5)
- R1 [PASS] Pass the prepared plate to R2. (r1_s6)
agent_plans.R2:
[0-5 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Prepare a quick meal (e.g., sandwich) in the kitchen (r1_s1)
- R2 [RECEIVE] Wait to receive the meal from R1 (r2_s1)

[5-10 min]
- R1 [PASS] Hand the prepared meal to R2 (r1_s2)
- R2 [RECEIVE] Receive the meal from R1 (r2_s2)
- R2 [LOCAL] Move to the living room with the meal (r2_s3)
- R2 [LOCAL] Place the meal on the table in the living room (r2_s4)
agent_plans.R3:
[0-5 min]
- R3 [LOCAL] Pick up the laptop from the couch and place it neatly on the coffee table. (r3_s1)
- R3 [LOCAL] Pick up the magazine from the couch and place it neatly on the coffee table. (r3_s2)

[5-10 min]
- R3 [LOCAL] Slice an apple from the fruit bowl on the coffee table. (r3_s3)
- R3 [LOCAL] Pour a glass of juice from the pitcher on the coffee table. (r3_s4)
agent_plans.R4:
[0-5 min]
- R4 [LOCAL] Move any heavy objects blocking pathways to ensure clear access to the door and essential items. (r4_s1)
- R4 [LOCAL] Tidy up the coffee table by moving any heavy objects to their designated places. (r4_s2)

[5-10 min]
- R4 [LOCAL] Ensure the couch area is clear by moving any heavy objects to the shelves or appropriate storage. (r4_s3)
- R4 [LOCAL] Double-check the room for any remaining heavy objects that need to be moved to maintain a tidy appearance. (r4_s4)
